title: Understanding Residual Plots
text: A residual plot shows the difference between observed and predicted values. A good fit in a linear regression model is indicated by a residual plot where the points are randomly scattered around the horizontal axis.

title: Analyzing Plot A
text: In Plot A, notice if there is any pattern or trend in the residuals. A pattern might suggest that the model is not capturing some aspect of the data.

title: Analyzing Plot B
text: Look at Plot B and observe how the residuals are distributed. Are they randomly scattered, or do they form a pattern? Random scatter indicates a good fit.

title: Analyzing Plot C
text: Examine Plot C for any visible patterns in the residuals. A curve or trend might indicate that the model is not fitting the data well.

title: Choosing the Best Fit
